# A library struct a build declares beside the program's own reaches every
# backend by name, and a program may declare the same name: gtk4's `arcTo`
# takes a `draw.Point`, a `draw.path` a `draw.Style`, and gtk4's widgets hold a
# `Look`. The build renames the library's copy, keeping the program's
# (draw.Point is Point__draw), and points every copy of the declaration at the
# renamed one: a frozen library function held the original, so gtk4/c kept a
# `Look` beside `Look__gtk4` and gtk4/go compared one with the other. Before, the
# build declined: "rename the local one". FuzzPipeline found gtk4/c's.

sngl test --platform=none clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric clash.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- clash.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

struct Point {
    label string = ""
}

struct Look {
    weight int = 0
}

struct Style {
    bold bool = false
}

component main ui.node {
    var p = Point{label="x"}
    var look = Look{weight=700}
    var style = Style{bold=true}

    ui.text #shown(value="{p.label} {look.weight} {style.bold}")
    draw.canvas(width=40px, height=20px) {
        draw.path(style=draw.Style{stroke=color{r=255}}) {
            draw.arcTo(cx=1.0, cy=1.0, x=2.0, y=2.0, r=1.0)
        }
        draw.canvasText(x=0.0, y=0.0, content=p.label, style=draw.Style{fill=color{b=255}})
    }
}

func testClash(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "x 700 true")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
